decision: zoomOffset -1 on the DEM TileLayer and MESH_STEP 2
why: a z(n-1) tile at step 2 has the vertex spacing of a z(n) tile at step 4: same ground, a quarter of the requests (S3 is HTTP/1.1, 6 at a time)

decision: far-tile LOD (lib/demLod.ts coarsenFar + DemTileset) merging siblings only while the parent is no wider on screen than a centre tile; skirts on every tile
why: deck.gl takes all tiles at one zoom below 60 deg pitch; skirts hide cracks between mixed zooms and the existing 1-pixel step between neighbours
result: at 55 deg few tiles qualify (probe1 all z10): kept, it costs nothing and helps when the view reaches further

decision: per-frame mesh budget (8 ms) with a rebuild tick; cached the SimpleMeshLayer mesh object
why: a burst of tiles was meshed in one task; re-rendering sublayers on zoom passed a new mesh object every time

decision: precomputed the drawn surface per tile, in-place colour mixing, makeGround moved to lib/eraGround.ts with allocation-free bilinear sampling
why: a 129x129 tile took ~65-88 ms in jest, longer than a frame by itself; surfaceAt closure was the top self time
result: browser profile: no terrain code in any long task after boot

decision: named the remaining long tasks instead of chasing them: React hydration at boot (0.2-0.4 s, before tiles stream) and a React re-render ~7 s in
